# Type, density and spacing

<!-- Generated by `bin/drgnx design` from core/drgnx-type-faces.el and modules/ui/drgnx-look-density.el. Do not edit; change the source and regenerate. -->

drgnx sets type in **roles**, not fonts. A role is a family, a size, a weight and (for code) a line height; every role can be changed in the settings (`drgnx-look-font-ROLE`). Sizes are ratios to the code size (13.5 logical pixels), so zooming scales every role together. A logical pixel is 3/4 of a point; the display's scale and the UI scale (`drgnx-look-scale`, 100 to 200 %) turn logical pixels into device pixels through `drgnx-px`, and a size never appears in chrome code as a bare number.

## Roles

A role that names another role as its family takes what it leaves out from that role.

| Role | Family | Fallbacks | Size (× code) | Pixels | Weight | Line height |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | JetBrains Mono | Adwaita Mono, monospace | 1.0 | 13.5 | regular | 21 |
| `ui` | Adwaita Sans | Inter, sans-serif | 0.963 | 13.0 | regular | - |
| `ui-heading` | Adwaita Sans | Inter, sans-serif | 0.963 | 13.0 | semibold | - |
| `ui-caption` | Adwaita Sans | Inter, sans-serif | 0.889 | 12.0 | regular | - |
| `title` | Adwaita Sans | Inter, sans-serif | 1.259 | 17.0 | semibold | - |
| `code-small` | JetBrains Mono | Adwaita Mono, monospace | 0.889 | 12.0 | regular | 19 |
| `agent` | Adwaita Sans | Inter, sans-serif | 0.963 | 13.0 | regular | - |
| `terminal` | JetBrains Mono | Adwaita Mono, monospace | 1.0 | 13.5 | regular | 21 |

## Faces

The faces that carry the roles. They choose letters only; colour comes from the [tokens](tokens.md).

| Face | Family | Height (× code) | Weight | For |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `drgnx-ui-text` | Adwaita Sans | 0.963 | regular | The user interface's text: tab bar, status bar, lists, palette candidates and notices. |
| `drgnx-ui-heading` | Adwaita Sans | 0.963 | semibold | Panel titles and section heads. |
| `drgnx-ui-caption` | Adwaita Sans | 0.889 | regular | The status bar, meta text and the tree's end column. |
| `drgnx-ui-title` | Adwaita Sans | 1.259 | semibold | The start page's and the reviews' headings. |
| `drgnx-code-small` | JetBrains Mono | 0.889 | regular | Diffs and output inside cards. |
| `drgnx-agent-prose` | Adwaita Sans | 0.963 | regular | The agent panel's prose. |
| `drgnx-terminal` | JetBrains Mono | - | regular | The terminal's text. |

## Density

`drgnx-look-density` (compact, comfortable, roomy) sets these sizes, in logical pixels. The heights of rows, tabs and bars come from here; gaps and padding come from the 4, 8, 12, 16 and 24 scale through `drgnx-px`.

| Size | Compact | Comfortable | Roomy |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code-line` | 19 | 21 | 23 |
| `tree-row` | 22 | 26 | 30 |
| `tab-row` | 30 | 34 | 38 |
| `status-bar` | 22 | 24 | 28 |
| `title-row` | 34 | 38 | 42 |
| `gap` | 4 | 6 | 8 |
| `panel-padding` | 8 | 12 | 16 |
| `tree-indent` | 12 | 12 | 14 |

## Icon size

An icon is 16 logical pixels (14 in dense rows), drawn with a stroke of 1.6 in its 24-unit box. See [icons](icons.md).
